name: Smoke Fixture
description: Invented content used by the headless render check. Exercises both pack behaviours: extending a group the app already ships, and creating one it does not.

conditions.name: Becalmed
conditions.summary: Cannot act on the first round of combat.
lines: The creature is incapacitated until the end of its first turn.
Ends early if it takes damage.

diseases.name: Lantern Rot
diseases.summary: A faint glow, then a dimming of the senses.
lines: The creature's skin glows faintly for 1d4 days.
It has disadvantage on Perception checks until cured.
diseases.note: Invented for the smoke check. Not a real disease.

entries.name: Borrowed Spell
entries.summary: Extends a tab the app already ships.
lines: Proves that a group id matching a bundled one merges rather than replaces.

abilityGroups.title: Fixture Tricks
abilityGroups.blurb: A tab that exists only because this pack declares it.

entries.name: New Tab Trick
entries.summary: Proves a pack can create a tab of its own.
lines: A group id the app has never heard of becomes its own tab.
